description: List the webhook endpoints registered on the authenticated account. Each endpoint includes its id, URL, subscribed events, status (ACTIVE|DISABLED), consecutive failure count, last success/failure timestamps, last error, and signing secret. Porkbun POSTs a signed JSON payload to each endpoint when subscribed events occur; deliveries are signed with the endpoint's secret via HMAC-SHA256 over `{timestamp}.{rawBody}` and sent in the `X-Porkbun-Signature` header.
name: list_webhooks
title: List Webhooks
